achievements.label: No Turning Aside
achievements.unlockMessage: This was necessary. [You ascended to become the Chandler, winning the Second Dawn and bringing forward the destined dusk in advance.]

achievements.label: Steel Revolution
achievements.descriptionLocked: We shall at last create a new world: pure, bright, and perfect. And that shall be the Dawn most magnificent, and beautiful.
achievements.descriptionUnlocked: We shall at last create a new world: pure, bright, and perfect. And that shall be the Dawn most magnificent, and beautiful.
achievements.unlockMessage: We shall at last create a new world: pure, bright, and perfect. And that shall be the Dawn most magnificent, and beautiful. [You have become the first God-from-Steel, and you will bring the Dawn and restore the order of the entire world.]

achievements.label: The Sun Returns to Noon
achievements.descriptionLocked: I shall walk with him under the most ascendant name... as of old.
achievements.descriptionUnlocked: I shall walk with him under the most ascendant name... as of old.
achievements.unlockMessage: I shall walk with him under the most ascendant name... as of old. [You opened the way for the Sun-in-Splendour to return, and became his most prominent Name.]

achievements.label: Before the Dawn
achievements.descriptionLocked: At least for now, I already have everything I need. And that is already enough.
achievements.descriptionUnlocked: At least for now, I already have everything I need. And that is already enough.
achievements.unlockMessage: At least for now, I already have everything I need. And that is already enough. [You won this war in your own way - perhaps this is the best ending.]

achievements.label: Beneath the Soil
achievements.descriptionLocked: I could rise no higher, nor would I ever be found.
achievements.descriptionUnlocked: I could rise no higher, nor would I ever be found.
achievements.unlockMessage: I could rise no higher, nor would I ever be found. [You were slain by the Huntress, Kitling Ripe of the Velvet.]

achievements.label: The End of Gluttony
achievements.descriptionLocked: A sweet red tide devoured me.
achievements.descriptionUnlocked: A sweet red tide devoured me.
achievements.unlockMessage: A sweet red tide devoured me. [You were slain by the Huntress, Lagiah, the Queen Unsated of the Red Grail.]

achievements.label: A Reckoning
achievements.descriptionLocked: The Madrugad will take her due in the end.
achievements.descriptionUnlocked: The Madrugad will take her due in the end.
achievements.unlockMessage: The Madrugad will take her due in the end. [你被昕旦的女猎手，斯卡蒂所杀。]

achievements.label: Not Observed to Act
achievements.descriptionLocked: Unmoved, still watching over his domain.
achievements.descriptionUnlocked: Unmoved, still watching over his domain.
achievements.unlockMessage: No wave escapes his piercing, watchful eye, Which shines as he surveys his watery sphere. The one-eyed king appears once more in strength, Unmoved, still watching over his domain. [You became a Name of the Witness - who watches, and is not observed to act.]

achievements.label: Dawn of Blood
achievements.descriptionLocked: One day, then, sooner than you think, the world will be all aflame.
achievements.descriptionUnlocked: One day, then, sooner than you think, the world will be all aflame.
achievements.unlockMessage: One day, then, sooner than you think, the world will be all aflame. [You were devoured by the Wolf-Divided, and he will bring the Dawn of blood.]

achievements.label: Feast of the Blackbone
achievements.descriptionLocked: A reckoning, is not to be postponed indefinitely.
achievements.descriptionUnlocked: A reckoning, is not to be postponed indefinitely.
achievements.unlockMessage: A reckoning, is not to be postponed indefinitely. [You were devoured by the Blackbone, and were reborn as one of her Names.]

achievements.label: Shaking the Hours
achievements.descriptionLocked: To ring this bell may scarcely be called wise, yet how rich the reward!
achievements.descriptionUnlocked: To ring this bell may scarcely be called wise, yet how rich the reward!
achievements.unlockMessage: To ring this bell may scarcely be called wise, yet how rich the reward! [You have awakened the strike-tone of the bell of Ys - the tremor that once shattered the moon and drove the sun out of the sky.]

achievements.label: A Destined Victory
achievements.descriptionLocked: I have washed away my shame and cleared my path.
achievements.descriptionUnlocked: I have washed away my shame and cleared my path.
achievements.unlockMessage: I have washed away my shame and cleared my path. [You defeated a legendary opponent - the Name of the Madrugad who hunts those might become Hours, and once defeated you in Caen.]

achievements.label: THE WOUND
achievements.descriptionLocked: The Sun was divided, and this is its wound.
achievements.descriptionUnlocked: The Sun was divided, and this is its wound.
achievements.unlockMessage: The Sun was divided, and this is its wound. [You defeated the god of pain and unmaking, and thus bore the pain of the Sun yourself.]
